label: Heavy going
summary: Another tanker caught fire near the Strait of Hormuz, and oil above $100 hung over G20 finance ministers meeting in Bangkok. Trump said US ground troops in Iran were unlikely. Ukraine was reported to have run out of Patriot interceptors, and Israel halted commercial goods into Gaza. Children were the day's heaviest losses: a school roof collapse in Pakistan killed 32 pupils and a teacher, and a shooting at an Oregon elementary school killed three children and a teacher. Smoke haze turned Indonesian skies orange, and Arctic sea ice hit another low. There were brighter notes too. Somalia set elections for 2027, a tribe moved close to recovering ancestral land on the Elwha River, ESA's new Sentinel-3C satellite sent its first images, and scientists found a new defence against a crop-killing fungus. The weighted formula gave 38; no editorial adjustment.
